 ## #5→0
 
+
+The 1935 citizenship law and its first regulation make an ancestry classification consequential through voting and public office. The deciding institution converts its category into a distribution of rights, then presents that instituted distinction as natural being. The [language, law and nation history](../histories/places-and-peoples/language-law-nation-centralisation/DEVELOPMENT.md#branch-vii-germany) **historicises** this closure through those two instruments; Fichte’s earlier address remains a different witness, with the intervening conduits still requiring their own evidence.
+
 [Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-recognition-return): The complete Māyā return **figures** the difference between necessary measure and its usurpation through the six generated relations. Continuity-in-Indeterminacy preserves origin/unmeasurable; Criterion-through-Distinction gives measure; Delineation-through-Difference gives frame; Arbitration-in-Crisis makes decision consequential and exposes hybris; Con-text-through-Diaphaneity enables Regard; Resolution-in-Reconciliation enables Anamnesis. The returned question is which criterion changed and which excluded relation could answer. Constitutive veiling remains positive manifestation rather than already being the secondary seizure of authority.
 
 Taylor’s [black sun and radiating star](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#black-sun-radiating-star) **figures** measure protecting its authority by first excluding interiority and then counting the resulting absence as evidence. The authored rings of philanthropy, capital, fixing and their compromising corona distribute dependence and the cost of exit. Cynicism consumes the capacity to answer, and blankness becomes available for reinscription under the same criterion. The star’s return releases capacity to question that measure; it does not demand transfer of allegiance to another centre. These are admitted authorial image operations, with no empirical allegation supplied by their personifications.

@@ -53,6 +53,9 @@
 
 ## #5→0
 
+
+The [language, law and nation history](../histories/places-and-peoples/language-law-nation-centralisation/DEVELOPMENT.md#branch-x-abrahamic) **compares** the covenant through its source, interpreter, obligation and jurisdiction. Torah and halakhic continuity, Christian transregional and vernacular institutions, and Qur’anic Arabic within a multilingual umma distribute those offices differently. A mediating office receives authority through a particular relation; the comparison supplies no single Abrahamic constitutional chronology, and its selected Peters passages remain a separate source task.
+
 Taylor’s [God–city–bomb–surveillance–AI sequence](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#god-city-bomb-surveillance-ai) **figures** distinct ways a mediating apparatus can appropriate the source-office. Destruction removes a city’s shared conditions; surveillance can retain its buildings while capturing the persons who inhabit them; a fabricated image can present itself as originating witness. An entrusted office answers to these differences when the people and conditions it mediates can change its commission. The sequence’s historical telling and Giegerich relation remain separate source tasks, while the authored distinction between destruction, capture and counterfeit provenance is retained.
 
 The mediating office **returns-to** [Arbitration-in-Crisis → Decision / Hybris](../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#arbitration-in-crisis) through its received power to settle a consequential dispute. Primary standing, an authorised interpretation and an executed decision remain different offices. Returned labour and affected consequence must be able to revise the commission, so the mediator’s necessary judgment does not appropriate the authority from which it was entrusted to act.

@@ -41,6 +41,9 @@
 
 ## #5→0
 
+
+The [language, law and nation history](../histories/places-and-peoples/language-law-nation-centralisation/DEVELOPMENT.md#branch-xii-computation) **tests** disclosure by whether a returned consequence can alter the criterion which produced it. DPO’s optimal and reference policies have distinct mathematical offices; the institutional account must also identify who selected the preference data, proxy and use. Ostrom’s selected principles supply a comparison for affected users changing rules and for nested governance. Their presence in an account establishes neither an implemented computational return nor a verdict on phenomenality.
+
 Taylor’s [erased taijitu](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#erased-taijitu) **figures** divided participants whose internal plurality has been removed while the power of recombination is retained elsewhere. The [black sun–radiating star whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#black-sun-radiating-star) **extends** this accounting through private play’s protected decisions and public work’s visible performance. Its rings of philanthropy, capital, fixing and mutual compromise give the withheld return a differentiated body. The healthy Power–Play–Need–Sacrifice–Decision–Love–Work circulation remains coequal with Name–Truth–Mind–Word–Logos–Son–Image; release returns capacity and consequence to the commissioning relation. The [city–bomb–surveillance–AI sequence](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#god-city-bomb-surveillance-ai) **qualifies** this return by retaining destruction, capture within a continuing habitat and counterfeit source as different mechanisms. Their authored force does not certify a particular institution or technical case.
 
 Delegated labour **returns-to** [Nomos — answerable office](../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#nomos-answerable-office) through the rule connecting commissioner, performer, recipient and bearer of consequence. Their positions need not coincide. Returning the product must also allow encountered cost or dissent to revise the commission. Renewed entrustment can then proceed on examined terms, while the institution’s inherited authority remains attributable rather than naturalised.

@@ -21,6 +21,8 @@
 A stable standard differs from a protected account through its declared warrant, scope and return conditions. It need not change whenever challenged: evidence can vindicate it, and a bounded task can require consistency. Protection begins when no encountered resistance can reach the office authorised to reconsider those conditions. QH R16.4 names the returning material: error, cost, dissent, unforeseen possibility and consequences of labour must be able to change model, measure, instruction, institution or purpose.
 
 ## #5→0
+
+[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-frame-usurpation): The frame calling its boundary the horizon **figures** a protected criterion’s source-claim. It redescribes whatever cannot be admitted as unreal or already explained, then receives the other person’s reply as confirmation. Returning the frame to its history restores a route by which an excluded witness can change the criterion. Necessary selection remains effective after that immunity ends.
 
 E2’s Criterion through distinction makes the criterion itself answerable to what the account encounters. Arbitration can sustain a valid distinction; occupation begins when its office exempts that distinction from return. The protected account therefore returns to [E2’s criterion through distinction](../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#criterion-through-distinction): correction must be able to reach the rule that decides what counts as correction.

 C53 **returns-to** [A29](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) with the completed relation: apportioned capacity acts, encounters consequence and returns evidence and value to a field capable of revising its commission. +[the Job whole](../../mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-consequence-return) **figures** the separation of permission from suffered consequence. The heavenly test reaches labourers, children and the afflicted body, while those who bear these costs do not set its terms. The appointed return asks whether consequence can reach the authority that commissions an action. A successful outcome for the principal cannot by itself answer the losses borne by others.
+
+[the Prisoner whole](../../mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-administered-world) **figures** power carried by an office across the replacement of its bearer. The succession of Numbers Two keeps the Village's interrogation and confinement operative, so responsibility cannot end with a personnel change. Degree Absolute brings consequence back upon an incumbent without by itself revising the apparatus. The return concerns whether costs can reach the purpose and permissions of delegated labour, not merely the delegate's performance.
+
 **Depth Restoration:** restored product-up/consequence-down asymmetry, criterion-revising return and the public-work/hidden-decision inversion from A25/A28/A29/A30/A33/A35's recovered field and direct QH/Q27 carriers. No identity change.
